page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. The system is provisioned with 52 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It includes 384.0 GB of total RAM, which yields a memory-to-core ratio of 7.38 GB per virtual processor, targeting workloads that require extensive memory capacity alongside sustained compute resources.

Hardware input reveals no bundled local storage and zero GPU accelerators, meaning persistent data management relies on external network block storage. Networking capability includes a baseline bandwidth allocation of 12 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance. In terms of resource efficiency, the hardware configuration provides high memory density relative to core count, allowing organizations running memory-bound operations to avoid over-allocating superfluous CPU capacity.

The ecs.r6.13xlarge is suited for memory-intensive enterprise software, including in-memory databases, Redis or Memcached clusters, big data processing pipelines, and large relational database deployments where disk I/O can be offloaded to external network storage.
